name: Spiral Sanctuary
summary: A sculptural spiral minaret rises beside a low prayer hall, with one continuous warm ramp wrapping its surface.
why: The ramp follows a single continuous curved route within the tapering tower. The tower and hall overlap structurally at their shared foundation, while their generous arch openings stay aligned at ground level.
risk: The spiral is clearest in color. In monochrome it simplifies to a terraced minaret; the small adjoining hall keeps the architectural reading.
reasonToChoose: You want a mosque silhouette defined by its minaret rather than a central dome.
